messages:
maria: Heads-up: billing blip during canary. A streaming session was preempted mid-request, router handed it off to fallback, and a toolcall retried. Customer saw ~4 token double-charge.
jake: Any IDs/logs?
maria: session=sess_8b9f, toolcall=tc_44a. Router snippet: `[02:13:22.112] PREEMPT session=sess_8b9f -> route=canary-1`, `[02:13:22.224] HANDOFF -> fallback-std`, `[02:13:22.337] TOOLCALL_RETRY id=tc_44a retry=1`.
kevin: Billing ledger created two provisionals and both were confirmed (pv_901 3 tokens, pv_902 4 tokens). Looks like dedupe missed because prefix hashes differed.
anya: Our dedupe key is (session, prefix_hash). If router split the prefix differently, hashes won't match.
kevin: Proposal: support adjacency-based dedupe using token ranges (start/end). Runtime knows offsets; add `prefix_range` to router events and check overlap in reconciler.
anya: We need to thread start/end through pipeline. Costly but doable.
jake: Short term: suppress auto-confirm for provisionals created within 500ms of a handoff for same session. Quick patch to billing-bot.
maria: +1. Also add dashboard panel and alert: "session-split-duplicates" and heatmap by route pairs.
kevin: I'll write RFC for overlap dedupe and schema change. Jake: PR for billing-bot timeout and alert?
jake: On it. Will add alert rule: notify #eng-platform if double-confirm rate>0 in 24h.
maria: I'll file ticket, attach traces, and ask support to reconcile invoice.
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_901 amount_tokens=3 source=canary-1 session=sess_8b9f
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_902 amount_tokens=4 source=fallback-std session=sess_8b9f
billing-bot: confirm id=pv_901 status=confirmed
billing-bot: confirm id=pv_902 status=confirmed
maria: Thanks all. DM me for raw traces.
